newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS reaffirms Edper ratings after merger.
newsitem.headline: CBRS reaffirms Edper ratings after merger.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday it confirmed the ratings on Edper Group Ltd after the amalgamation of Hees International Bancorp Inc and Edper Group Ltd.

CBRS confirmed the ratings on Edper's commercial paper at A-2 (High), senior debentures at B++, subordinated debentures at B++ (Low), subordinated convertible auction notes at B+ (High), subordinated convertible adjustable rate notes at B+ and preferred shares, class A and AA, at P-3 (Low).
The rating outlook was stable, CBRS said.
The amalgamation of Edper and Hees has been effective since Jan 1, 1997, CBRS said.
It said the overall effect of the deal on the financial profile of the new amalgamated company would be slightly positive.
